> How your products reach the storefront: you create them with prices and stock, and the operator reviews them when product requests are enabled.

Every product you create belongs to your store; only your store can see, edit, or delete it. Prices and stock are set on its variants. When product requests are enabled, creating or editing a product submits it for the marketplace operator to review.

You manage products from "Products" in the sidebar. Each product shows a status, such as "Draft", "Proposed", "Published", or "Rejected".
